payload.name: Redesign cart page UI/UX
payload.description: Check the frontend UI/UX of the /cart page in this Laravel + Livewire + Tailwind bookstore project, identify all UX issues, and redesign the /cart page with improved visual hierarchy, better empty state, enhanced order summary, mobile-optimized layout, and stronger trust signals. The redesign must match the existing design system (neutral/border-based aesthetic with brand-red accents, Inter font, max-w-7xl containers).
